svg.title: Daily GET 200 requests to the main documentary population, provider-origin automated AI roles, by site
svg.desc: Three column charts, one per site, of daily GET 200 requests to the main documentary population from provider-origin automated AI roles over 30 UTC days; requests occur on 12 of these days; 30 days carry a partial archive report.
svg.text: Unit: requests per UTC day. Same
linear scale for the three panels;
gaps are withheld in the revised
projection. A flat tick is a
recorded zero: no such request in
